Title: Sovereign settlement scene index
CoverageNote: 128 curated settlements in 12 polities, including 40 Qing settlements. This is an included-content index, not a complete historical world gazetteer. The final day of the supported campaign, 1 January 1846, is included.

GeographicReference.Title: Natural Earth populated places: current geographic reference
GeographicReference.License: Natural Earth data is public domain; the included descriptors and rounded catalog annotations are authored for this scenario.
GeographicReference.CoordinateProvenance: Rounded scenario coordinates from GeographyCatalog. Natural Earth provides a present-day geographic reference, not an 1836 survey or a complete historical-settlement list. These entries are not a direct import of a historical census.

HistoricalQualification: Historical English names and polity groupings are provisional curated annotations. Boundaries, dependencies and disputed administrations are not exhaustively reconstructed. Damascus is grouped by Ottoman nominal sovereignty; Egyptian administration in 1832–1840 is not simulated.
PopulationQualification: Population and economic figures in the simulation are scenario estimates, not census observations. This scene index contains no asserted historical population data.
SceneQualification: Descriptors request deterministic procedural composites. Empty AuthoredScenePath means no authored historical city reconstruction is supplied. Metadata is loaded one settlement at a time when the view is requested.
